scope: credential-free local synthetic SQLite backup creation and restore admission
controls: session names are non-empty and versions are positive
session status is restricted to active or closed
createdAt and updatedAt are canonical and chronologically ordered
active sessions cannot carry closedAt and closed sessions require a canonical in-window closedAt
session nodeIds exactly and uniquely match nodes bound to the session
node relationship errors retain their specific fail-closed classification before session index validation
limitations: Synthetic local fixtures do not qualify live collaborative transport or production recovery behavior.
S-01 remains in progress pending independent review and separately authorized external reliability evidence.
